description: All 148 CSS color names with hex values — search, click to copy, or convert hex back to a name.

faqs.a: Yes — all 148 official CSS color keywords, including grey spellings and rebeccapurple.
faqs.q: Does it include every CSS color?

faqs.a: The search box filters by name or hex instantly.
Click any color row to copy its hex value.
faqs.q: How do I copy a hex value?

faqs.a: If there's no exact match, the closest color by RGB distance is shown — clearly labeled as approximate.
faqs.q: What if my hex has no exact name?

howto: Search or scroll the 148 CSS color names.
Click a color to copy its hex.
Or paste a hex to find its name (exact or nearest).
